title: HYTHE by Botanica
location: Cherngtalay (Choeng Thale), within Botanica Grand Avenue / Laguna Phuket area
shortDescription: HYTHE by Botanica is a low-rise condominium in the Laguna Phuket / Cherngtalay area, within the Botanica Grand Avenue development.
description: HYTHE by Botanica is a low-rise condominium in the Laguna Phuket / Cherngtalay area, within the Botanica Grand Avenue development. It is the first condominium project by Botanica Luxury Villas and is marketed as a vertical villa. The project comprises four six-storey buildings and a clubhouse, with one- to three-bedroom units, duplexes with private pools and penthouses.
